data.query: Which course has the highest fee at NPGC?
data.answer: B.Com (ACCA) and B.Com (CFA) have HIGHEST fees at NPGC: ₹60,000 per semester (₹360,000 total for 3 years). These premium programs include international professional certifications (ACCA/CFA) and specialized training for global careers.

data.query: Which course has the lowest fee at NPGC?
data.answer: B.Voc. (Software Development & E-Governance) and B.Voc. (Banking & Finance) have LOWEST fees at NPGC: ₹26,000 per year (₹78,000 total for 3 years). These skill-based vocational programs are most affordable with multiple exit options.

data.query: What is the fee difference between regular B.Com and B.Com (ACCA/CFA) at NPGC?
data.answer: Regular B.Com (Hons.): ₹28,600/semester (₹171,600 total). B.Com (ACCA/CFA): ₹60,000/semester (₹360,000 total). Difference: ₹31,400/semester (₹188,400 total for 3 years). Premium cost due to international certification and specialized training.

data.query: Are there different fees for regular and self-finance seats at NPGC?
data.answer: For LUACMAT 2026 UG programs at NPGC: All programs listed have the SAME FEE STRUCTURE regardless of category (no separate self-finance fees mentioned in prospectus). For LUACCET programs (B.Com 550 seats: 220 Regular + 330 Self-Finance), specific fee differentiation is NOT specified. Contact NPGC at 0522-4021304 for self-finance fee details.
data.status: Regular and Self-Finance fees are NOT differentiated in prospectus

charges.query: What are the additional fees I need to pay at NPGC?
charges.answer: Additional charges beyond course fees: (1) Counselling fee: ₹500 (cash at counselling), (2) Caution Money: refundable, typically ₹3,000-10,000 (decided by college), (3) Registration fee: ₹500, (4) Admission process fee: ₹500, (5) University exam fee: varies per semester (typically ₹2,500-3,500), (6) For apprenticeship programs: additional training cost.

charges.query: Can I pay admission fees online at NPGC?
charges.answer: Yes, NPGC accepts multiple payment methods: (1) Pay Order/DD in favor of National P.G. College, (2) Online at www.npgc.in, (3) QR Code, (4) Debit/Credit Card (+ banking service charges), (5) Internet Banking (+ banking service charges). Choose the method most convenient for you.

charges.query: Can I get a refund if I cancel my admission at NPGC?
charges.answer: Yes, requests for cancellation and fee refund: (1) Within 7 days: NPGC will entertain full refund requests. (2) After 7 days: Contact your allotted college directly (NPGC or participant college). Refund subject to college policies. Note: Caution money is refundable upon completion or cancellation as per college norms.

charges.query: Are there scholarships available for NPGC admission?
charges.answer: Yes, NPGC offers multiple scholarships: (1) SC/ST candidates: Government scholarships (percentage varies), (2) OBC candidates: Government scholarships available, (3) Merit-based scholarships: For General category top performers, (4) Nirdhan Chhattra Nidhi: Fund for economically weak students, (5) IGNOU/UPRTOU distance programs: Zero fees for SC/ST eligible candidates. Contact NPGC at 0522-4021304 for current scholarship details.
